integrity: A complete universal algebraic proof and dependency-free finite verification script are included. Earlier general definitions and Brandt inverse-semigroup cases are credited; independent review is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns natural-conjugacy partial inner maps, not all partial automorphisms; group coefficient Rees matrices only. Independent auditing has not been performed; bibliographic equivalence remains a risk.
title: Partial inner automorphism monoids of Rees zero-matrix semigroups
